skills.name: Common-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share (or now share) a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike-denominator fractions and rewrite both as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition and subtraction
skills.definition: Split mixed numbers (or whole numbers, treated as having a zero fraction part) into whole and fraction components and subtract the whole parts and fraction parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing between whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Improper mixed-number normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fraction part is greater than or equal to one (e.g., 2 3/2) into proper form by moving the excess into the whole part before subtracting.
